issues.title: Lineage resolver conflates artifact integrity with nonempty evidence
issues.defect: Lineage usability is determined by file nonemptiness instead of separately checking presence/readability/schema/run integrity/evidence sufficiency.
issues.evidence: Known requirements include nonempty V551 atoms and multiple downstream artifacts.
issues.consequence: Valid empty/no-evidence runs are impossible; corrupt and semantically empty states are mixed with usefulness.
issues.required: Replace generic nonempty gate with producer manifest + artifact presence/readability/schema + run integrity + operation-specific evidence sufficiency.
tests: Valid empty V551 atom artifact with integrity PASS is lineage-valid.

issues.title: V551J lineage requires both certified and review surfaces to be nonempty
issues.defect: Current V551J lineage requires both a nonempty certified packet index and a nonempty reviewable sidecar.
issues.consequence: An immaculate all-certified run fails because review surface is empty; an all-review/no-certified run also fails.
issues.required: Require artifacts to exist/validate; cardinality is evidence state, not integrity. Determine downstream permission from typed V551J manifest.
tests: All-certified run with empty review sidecar remains lineage-valid.
Review-only valid run receives typed sufficiency state.

issues.title: V550J lineage requires association output even when association mode is off
issues.defect: Lineage requires a nonempty association index although the project has an explicit execution mode where association classification is disabled.
issues.evidence: Confirmed hostile-pass lineage census; July dependency ledger also notes CLI/smoke association-mode mismatch.
issues.consequence: A valid configured run is rejected for intentionally absent optional evidence.
issues.required: Make artifact requirement conditional on declared association mode and pin that mode in manifests/regression runs.
tests: association_mode=off does not require association index.

issues.title: V552 lineage requires nonempty `question_semantic_hierarchy` that the active producer intentionally emits empty
issues.defect: The current active V552 builder emits `question_semantic_hierarchy` as an empty compatibility surface, while lineage requires it to be nonempty.
issues.evidence: Confirmed hostile pass: current producer and resolver directly contradict each other.
issues.consequence: A correctly executed V552 run can be structurally impossible for lineage resolver to accept.
issues.required: Either remove the obsolete artifact from lineage requirements or define a real authoritative producer contract; do not require a knowingly empty compatibility artifact to contain rows.
tests: Current active V552 success can be resolved without synthetic hierarchy rows.

issues.title: Parquet row-count helper conflates valid empty with unreadable/corrupt
issues.defect: The row-count helper returns 0 both for a valid zero-row parquet and when the file cannot be parsed.
issues.consequence: Corruption and lawful absence become indistinguishable; fixing zero-evidence semantics without fixing this would weaken safety.
issues.required: Return separate read status/error and row count. Corrupt/unreadable hard-fails integrity; valid empty is a typed cardinality.

issues.title: Lineage semantics depend on substring matching in free-text statuses
issues.defect: Resolver detects readiness/blockage by testing strings for tokens such as `BLOCKED`, `NOT_READY`, and `READY`.
issues.consequence: Renaming a status can change pipeline behavior; `READY` substrings can collide with `NOT_READY`; semantic contracts are encoded in English labels.
issues.required: Use enumerated typed status fields/versioned manifest schema. Retain substring parsing only as explicit legacy adapter for old artifacts.
tests: New producer manifests are parsed by enums, not substrings.
